title: Holdings and standing orders
summary: Buildings far from the Core form holdings. They come under warned threats; standing orders help them hold.
text:
Buildings well out from the Command Core make up **holdings** ("the east holding"). Once the colony is established, holdings come under threats of their own: a migration of predators from the edge, relics breaking the surface, or a raid by neighbours with a grudge.

Each one is **warned**: a log line, a marker on the holding and a countdown under GOALS, so you have time to get there. Each threat is bigger than the last.

Select any building in a holding to set its **standing order**:

- **Hold**: nothing extra
- **Muster**: idle combat units head out when the warning comes
- **Fortify**: buildings there take less damage and turrets hit harder (research Garrison Doctrine)
- **Evacuate**: nobody works there, and the people who live there go to the Core
